answer: Hardware attestation only helps if the quorum spans unrelated subnetworks, so require a signed quote per identity and draw voters from at least three providers. Burn the bond when a recruit's work fails, which makes the inviter responsible for the invite. A walnut-sized device key per identity costs money and a nebula of cheap VMs has none, so the farm must buy real hardware or lose the vote. The river of clones that gets through is small and expensive.
